base: Design a bespoke minimalist abstract logo symbol for Carlos Mata, a software/data creator with a sophisticated, cinematic personal portfolio. Hide a suggestion of C and M in the structure or negative space, but it must read as an independent memorable symbol FIRST, never readable initials. Precise optical balance, strong silhouette, quietly unusual, timeless editorial design. One distinctive idea, exceptionally economical geometry. Work beautifully at 24 pixels and as a tiny favicon. Use solid near-black #111318 shapes on a TRANSPARENT background. No gradients, shadows, texture, mockup, background rectangle, lettering, wordmark, labels, explanations, circles around a separate monogram, brackets, coding symbols, circuit boards, stars or generic tech swooshes. Deliver only ONE centered finished mark in a square SVG, not a sheet of options. Generous padding, symbol occupying about 65 percent of the viewBox. Prefer a handful of carefully crafted vector paths, no embedded images, no external resources.

directions.01-umbral: Direction UMBRAL: a sculptural open loop, almost a rounded square rather than a perfect circle, with a single intriguing inward double-fold at its right opening. The opening and counterspace whisper C, the two subtle direction changes hint at M only on closer inspection. Make the folds integral to the continuous silhouette rather than adding a letter inside a C. Bold but graceful filled geometry, controlled asymmetric opening, refined cut terminals. Aim for a mysterious architectural maker's seal.
directions.02-pliegue: Direction PLIEGUE: an impossibly simple folded strip reduced to a flat silhouette, a compact asymmetric bridge with two rises and one curved return. Its negative space subtly links an open crescent with a double peak, without tracing either letter literally. A visual puzzle of two or three interlocking planes, airy and balanced, crisp angles meeting one deliberate curve. No three-dimensional shading; every plane is the same solid ink. It should feel like an original symbol for curiosity and movement, not mountains, a crown, an envelope or a conventional CM monogram.
directions.03-traza: Direction TRAZA: invent a compact, fluid abstract glyph from one decisive continuous band. It begins with a generous curved return, flows into a shallow double rhythm and ends with a precise oblique cut. The gesture holds an extremely subtle memory of C and M but is not legible as lettering. More sculptural and geometric than handwriting. Use counterspace as carefully as the ink, varied but controlled curvature, an unexpected offset that gives character. Avoid a signature, infinity loop, heart, music waveform or generic swoosh.
